title: Solid library of fundamental text styles
user_note: some great examples of ways to arrange text, cool text effects and styles, fonts, text effects, just a great library of all kinds of useful text styles/layouts/etc. - not necessarily high design or super graphical/art-forward, but it's a great fundamental reference to start with for understanding how to make text look good in a very simple fundamental way with some good basic styles and such to start with, would be great as a reference for more mundane/common text across a dashboard but not necessarily THE 'STYLE' you'd want for making a wallach quote popup 'wow you', it's moreso just a solid fallback reference
